Title: Publication, versioning, and clone-engine decomposition
Purpose: Separate publication lifecycle concerns from graph cloning, harden version/slug conflict handling, and remove publication-era dependence on legacy compatibility paths.
Deliverables: A separated publication service or equivalent internal responsibility split.
A separated clone engine or equivalent internal responsibility split.
Version/slug conflict handling that is race-aware and translated cleanly.
Publish/clone tests proving canonical dependency behavior still survives draft creation.
ReviewQuestions: Are publication lifecycle and clone responsibilities genuinely separated?
Are version/slug conflicts now handled explicitly?
Did the clone path stay faithful to the canonical dependency model?
CorrectiveOnFailure: If publication remains coupled or conflict-prone, trigger the runtime/query corrective playbook before runtime extraction begins.
